act_title: Scenes from Life in Meropide: Fists of Fury

quests.title: Scenes from Life in Meropide: Fists of Fury

dialogue.t: Young warrior, will you spar with me?
Uh, this is super sudden...
Whatever you say, lad(lass) with golden hair. I can tell that you're a veteran with just one look.
I'm really bored, because no one has been sparring with me. If you will, I'll give you Coupons! I won a lot of those from Roussimoff, and I haven't figured out how to spend them yet.
How about it?
Are you free now, lad(lass)? Spar with me!
Ha! Good! You're a straight talker!
Let's go somewhere spacious!

dialogue.sit: I'm a pacifist, and I don't like to fight.

dialogue.t: A pacifist that fights violence with violence? To each their own, I guess.
But this is not a fight, we're just sparring. We spar to better protect the peace. So if you're that sort of pacifist, we should definitely spar!

dialogue.sit: You have a point. Let's go!

dialogue.t: Ha! Very good!
Let's go somewhere spacious!

dialogue.sit: I can't do it right now. Maybe later.

dialogue.t: I'll be waiting for you here, then!
Nice! But let's go somewhere more spacious.
You... Fine, I'll wait for you here.
You sure left me hanging, lad(lass). Hope you remember that we weren't finished!
Enough talk. Let's do this!
Ha! Exhilarating!
I knew it, lad(lass)! You're a worthy opponent!

dialogue.sit: You've got some ways to go.

dialogue.t: It seems I need to work harder.
Anyway, I'm a straight-shooter, just like you. Here are your Coupons. Let's do this again sometime!
